classifier_authority.selection_method: largest eta_p5p6 R5 correction energy, deterministic eta_p4p5 and canonical-ID tie breaks

dof_budget.matrix_semantics: cell interiors are local Schur modes; only the shared low-order trace is globally numbered

limitations: MUMPS INFOG/RINFOG values are stored by raw index without inferred semantics.

full_operator_true_residual.full_operator_residual_method: explicit reduced trace+DtN Mat action combined with matrix-free dolfinx_mpc UFL action projected onto every active eliminated cell-interior test space, including condensed full-space RHS

full_explicit_true_residual.full_operator_residual_method: explicit reduced trace+DtN Mat action combined with matrix-free dolfinx_mpc UFL action projected onto every active eliminated cell-interior test space, including condensed full-space RHS

cell_static_condensation.true_residual_semantics: exact physically reduced C_t^H Schur C_t plus DtN operator residual; full FE matrix deliberately not allocated

entity_dof_inventory.current_backend_row_semantics: exact cell-interior elimination; measured global matrix retains only edge/face trace and DtN auxiliary rows
entity_dof_inventory.static_condensation_projection_semantics: measured_active_rows; exact cell-interior and Floquet-slave elimination with independent edge/face trace and DtN auxiliary unknowns retained

observable_comparison.same_code_band_definition: absolute p5-to-p6 change on the identical h10 mesh

diffraction_channel_comparison.same_code_band_definition: absolute p5-to-p6 channel change with explicit numerical floors
